column1: NEFU-China Open Microfluidic Platform bill of materials
1. This inventory records the equipment and consumables used in the platform.
2. Prices are historical purchase prices or estimates in CNY. Obtain current supplier quotations when ordering.
3. A blank price cell denotes an unquoted item; enter a supplier quotation during procurement.
4. The function generator and high-voltage amplifier belong to the DEP configuration. The magnetic-valve prototype uses a separate architecture.
5. The mCherry rows describe alternative excitation configurations. Select the LED or laser path and order its matching filters.
6. Obtain PMTCount.dll and the camera SDK with OEApi64.dll directly from the equipment suppliers.
7. Historical platform budget: approximately CNY 50,000-80,000. The separate magnetic-valve prototype was approximately CNY 10,000.
8. One LSP02-3B pump drives both phases: aqueous about 1.5 uL/min and oil 500 uL over 28.5 min (about 17.5 uL/min). Use the same pump for reinjection.
9. The reference incubation condition is 30 deg C for 16 h, as recorded in project report section 4.6.

Sources: existing-equipment inventory; phase-two configuration inventory; FourInOne R2 inventory; January-September 2026 project records (14 May, 10 September p. 2, 20 August p. 7); report section 4.6; hardware specifications.
